description: A PostgreSQL extension: a `vector` column type, distance operators, exact search and HNSW or IVFFlat indexes, inside the same transactions as the rest of the data.
Running the ANN search first and discarding results that fail the filter; a selective filter leaves too few results.
Restricting candidates to rows that match the filter before ranking by similarity, with a regular index or a filter-aware vector index.
The share of rows a filter matches; it decides whether exact search on the matches or a filter-aware ANN index is faster.
Combining keyword (BM25) and vector results into one ranking, for example with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
A partition of a managed vector index that every read and write targets; a common boundary for tenants.
The outbox or change data capture flow that keeps a separate vector store in step with the primary database, eventually consistent by design.
